title: HermesTV Source Health
description: Per-source health record captured by the backend probe. Attached to each provider entry on a catalog item. Chrome 76 compatible.

quality.description: Qualitative stream quality as observed by the probe.

codec.description: Codec string as reported by the source (e.g. h264, h265, av1).

bitrate_bucket.description: Bucketed bitrate range for the source stream.

startup_latency_ms.description: Time-to-first-frame in milliseconds as measured by probe.

buffering_events.description: Number of buffering stalls observed during probe window.

health_label.description: Human-readable health label derived from health_score.

fallback_available.description: Whether at least one alternative source is available if this one fails.

session_limit_status.description: Current concurrent-stream slot status for the provider account.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this health record was last probed.
